name: fund-allocation-report
description: Verified patterns for comparing portfolio positions to IPS target allocation and flagging rebalance triggers.

snippets.code:
total_aum = positions_df['market_value_usd'].sum()
current_allocation_df = (
    positions_df.groupby('asset_class', as_index=False)['market_value_usd']
    .sum()
    .assign(current_weight_pct=lambda d: d['market_value_usd'] / total_aum * 100)
    .sort_values('current_weight_pct', ascending=False)
)
snippets.comment: Always roll positions up to asset-class weights before comparing to IPS targets. Use market_value_usd, not fund count.
snippets.ai_context: Requires positions_df with columns asset_class and market_value_usd. Produces current_allocation_df with one row per asset class, including current_weight_pct as a percentage of total AUM. Run this before any IPS comparison.

snippets.code:
allocation_vs_ips_df = current_allocation_df.merge(ips_df, on='asset_class', how='left')
allocation_vs_ips_df['drift_from_target_pct'] = (
    allocation_vs_ips_df['current_weight_pct'] - allocation_vs_ips_df['target_weight_pct']
)
allocation_vs_ips_df['outside_band'] = (
    (allocation_vs_ips_df['drift_from_target_pct'].abs() > allocation_vs_ips_df['rebalance_band_pct'])
    | (allocation_vs_ips_df['current_weight_pct'] < allocation_vs_ips_df['min_weight_pct'])
    | (allocation_vs_ips_df['current_weight_pct'] > allocation_vs_ips_df['max_weight_pct'])
)
snippets.comment: A sleeve is outside band if drift exceeds the rebalance threshold OR weight breaches min/max — check both conditions.
snippets.ai_context: Requires current_allocation_df (from the weight rollup snippet) and ips_df with target_weight_pct, min_weight_pct, max_weight_pct, and rebalance_band_pct. Produces allocation_vs_ips_df with drift_from_target_pct and a boolean outside_band column. Filter outside_band == True to list sleeves that need rebalancing.
